PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy
PrivacyPolicy.subtitle: Policy
PrivacyPolicy.lastUpdated: Last updated: October 20, 2026. This privacy policy details how we securely handle, gather, and protect your specific platform information.
PrivacyPolicy.section1Desc: We limit our collection of data to provide a direct connection. We only collect your Username, Full Name, Email Address, and IP Address to ensure authentic access and operational stability on our launcher ecosystem.
PrivacyPolicy.section2Desc: Security is our core priority. Financial purchases are exclusively executed through our licensed billing operator, Xsolla. No credit cards, token histories, or financial parameters are ever logged or held directly on our servers.
PrivacyPolicy.section3Desc: You hold complete rights to erase your stored records. To secure accounts against accidental termination or single-click errors, we require an intentional multi-step deletion interface containing manual text input validation before permanently scrubbing credentials from our cloud infrastructure.
